title: Hunts FH-036S: Wire the Experience Pass into ticket checkout and the organizer screen

source.ref: Split from FH-036..040 (2026-11-10): the pure core, storage and tests shipped dark behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED; the live call sites move here.

detail:
Call resolvePurchase from the Event ticket checkout for a bound tier (canonical price, snapshot stored with the ticket, return path from passReturnPath, huntSalesOpen checked before any session is created), add the organizer screen that writes a binding through validateBinding, and an admin toggle for the sales kill switch. Done when: through the real checkout a forged price, wrong tier and closed switch are refused, and the owner has a drill record of closing and reopening sales. Requires: FH-036, FH-040, FH-035. Owner role: Events and billing.

Built 2026-11-11 (part): lib/hunts/pass-gate.ts is called from createTicketCheckout for a bound tier behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED. It refuses a wrong tier or Event, a non-fixed-price tier, a retired binding, a sold-out tier and a closed kill switch with a buyer line that names no rule; an unbound or unreadable tier sells as before. The sales kill switch is a staff-only action and form on /hunts/finance (hunt_commerce_set_sales, audited). Still open: the organizer screen that writes a binding through validateBinding (it needs the benefit codes a published Hunt version offers, which no reader exposes yet), storing the purchase snapshot with the ticket, and the owner's drill record. The verify file lib/hunts/pass-checkout.ts is deliberately not created until those land.
